items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: That's how I become interested in it. I used to sit down and listen to my uncle Adolf play the guitar.

ctx.x: We might get on with how you got interested in music, of course, with your uncles all playing. I guess you heard a lot of music from them when you were a kid.

That's how I become interested in it. I used to sit down and listen to my uncle Adolf play the guitar. He had one particular song he used to play all the time. It was, Baby Just a Spoonful. Yeah, I don't know that. And I was a kid and I'd just, he'd sit on the porch and play that when he'd get down and sing, and I'd just squat down right there by him and just listen. And well, later on when I got around about 13 years old, I bought my first set of drums. I had a little junior set of drums.
That was your very first instrument then? Very first. You wanted to be a drummer.
